title: Reading Between the Lines: Hidden Cultural Codes and the Hungarian Mindset
grammar: Complex sentence architectures and parenthetical qualification (*mindamellett, egyszersmind*)
goal: I can recognise cultural allusions and well-known sayings in Hungarian conversation.
I can use *egyszersmind* and *mindamellett* to add a second role or a caveat.
I can explain what it means to grasp the cultural unspoken nuances of native Hungarian conversations.
